hindsight_installer: scripts/install-hindsight.sh installs CLI 0.9.2 and missing coding-agent runtime >=0.5.3, pulls missing pinned images and enables database/app user units. --dry-run previews; --check is read-only; --no-start defers user service startup.
restore_order: Install Docker/Compose, Node >=22.15 with npm, Python >=3.11, Codex, EasyLlama and 9router; installed binaries and package caches are not copied.
Initialize 9router once, then stop it before restoring its exported configuration tables.
Render with a private values file and optionally --restore-router. OAuth/account stores were excluded and require fresh login.
Start EasyLlama and 9router-local, then run scripts/install-hindsight.sh as the logged-in destination user to install clients and activate the Hindsight user services.
Start a new Codex session after the local services and coding-agent runtime are available.
hindsight_data: Only empty persistent-data directories are created. Database contents and the imported corpus require a separate private backup.
hindsight_images: Pinned image digests and resource limits are preserved in the compose.yaml template.
